answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Consider a basalt at the center, a pigment resting nearby, and a oasis beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
